title: YukiCore
description: adds some enchantments to hoes and bows including some qol recipes
body:
**Combat Enchants for Hoes?**

**Multishot for Bows?**

**Early game redstone?**

**More qol recipes?**

Well now you can have all of these!!!

## Enchants:
### Harbinger's Requiem:
 This gives Hoes higher damage similar to an axe

### Harbinger's Blaze:
 This is just fire aspect BUT for Hoes

### Scythe Master:
 This increases range by +2 Blocks and gives them a SWEEP attack

### Triple Shot:
 This is just multishot BUT for Bows!!!
